plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) parse annotations.json — count annotations, categories, annotations per image distribution, (3) image dimensions, (4) category frequency distribution (how many categories have <5 annotations), (5) examine metadata.json structure, (6) check data/products/ directory structure and count reference images per product.
plan.success_criteria: Clear log of dataset statistics: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, category distribution, reference image counts

plan.title: Verify package versions and install pinned ultralytics
plan.description: In scratch.py, check installed versions of torch, torchvision, timm, ultralytics. Install ultralytics==8.1.0 if not present. Verify CUDA availability and GPU type. Log all versions.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed installed, torch/torchvision/CUDA working, GPU detected

plan.title: Examine store sections and annotation quality
plan.description: Parse annotations.json to identify store sections (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker) from image filenames or metadata. Check for 'corrected' field in annotations. Examine bbox size distribution (min/max/mean width and height). Check for any anomalies (zero-area boxes, out-of-bounds coords).
plan.success_criteria: Store sections identified per image, corrected annotation stats, bbox size distribution logged

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified train/val split
plan.description: Write a script that splits the 248 images into ~223 train and ~25 val, stratified by store section. Use seed=42. Output train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format (preserving all annotations for each image). Save to data/ directory.
plan.success_criteria: train_split.json (~223 images) and val_split.json (~25 images) created, proportional section representation verified

plan.title: Write evaluation function for val_score
plan.description: Create a reusable evaluation function in utils.py that: (1) takes predictions in COCO format and val_split.json as ground truth, (2) computes detection_mAP@0.5 (all predictions mapped to single category), (3) computes classification_mAP@0.5 (with original category_ids), (4) returns val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Use pycocotools COCOeval.
plan.success_criteria: Function tested with dummy predictions, returns correct val_score components

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write a conversion script that creates YOLO-format label files from train_split.json and val_split.json. Create the directory structure expected by ultralytics: images/train, images/val, labels/train, labels/val. Create a dataset YAML config file.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO format dataset created with correct label files, dataset.yaml points to correct paths

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Run inference on val split, evaluate with the evaluation function. This establishes the minimum baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score computed and logged, training completes successfully

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n by at least 0.05 val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n logged

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score over YOLOv8s
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m, nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=150, batch=8. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l improves val_score over YOLOv8m
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l, nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=200, batch=4-8. Evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x provides the best single-model val_score at 640px
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x, nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=200, batch=4. Evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against YOLOv8l

plan.title: Best model size at 1280px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Increasing resolution from 640 to 1280 improves detection mAP significantly due to small product sizes
plan.description: Take the best model size from steps 7-11, retrain at imgsz=1280 with reduced batch size (gradient accumulation if needed). Epochs=200-300. Evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over 640px version, detection_mAP specifically compared

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection-only) at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to distinguish classes
plan.description: Convert annotations to single class (all category_id=0). Train YOLOv8x at 1280px. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. This will be the detection backbone for the two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 higher than nc=357 model's detection_mAP

plan.title: Explore reference product images for embedding gallery
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory: count products with reference images, image types (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image quality/resolution. Map product codes to category_ids using metadata.json. Determine gallery coverage — what fraction of 357 categories have reference images?
plan.success_criteria: Complete mapping of category_id to available reference images, coverage statistics logged

plan.title: Build DINOv2-base embedding pipeline
plan.description: Write code to: (1) load DINOv2-base (vit_base) from torch hub or timm, (2) extract embeddings from image crops, (3) build a gallery from reference product images + training annotation crops, (4) implement kNN classification (k=5, cosine similarity). Test on a few val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces embeddings and kNN predictions for cropped detections

plan.title: Two-stage: nc=1 detector + DINOv2-base classification
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach (nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 kNN) achieves higher val_score than single-stage nc=357 YOLO
plan.description: Use nc=1 detector from step 13 for boxes. For each detection, crop from full-res image, extract DINOv2-base embedding, classify via kNN against gallery. Evaluate full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against best single-stage model

plan.title: Tune kNN parameters for DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing k, temperature, and distance metric improves classification_mAP
plan.description: Sweep k={1,3,5,7,11}, temperature={0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5}, distance={cosine,L2} on val split using detections from best detector. Also test distance-weighted vs majority voting.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN config identified, classification_mAP improvement logged

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: Optimal mix of reference images and training crops in gallery improves classification
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) reference images only, (b) training crops only, (c) both with equal weight, (d) training crops weighted 2x, (e) reference main/front images repeated 3x. Evaluate classification_mAP for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified with highest classification_mAP

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection_mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8} and confidence threshold {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.25, 0.3} on val split using best detector. Evaluate detection_mAP for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/confidence thresholds found, detection_mAP improvement logged

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA (multi-scale + flip) improves detection_mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run best detector with augment=True on val split. Measure detection_mAP and inference time. Compare against non-TTA baseline.
plan.success_criteria: TTA val_score and inference time logged, compared to non-TTA

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference with overlapping 1280x1280 crops significantly improves detection of small products
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice each image into overlapping tiles (1280x1280, stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Use best detector model. Evaluate detection_mAP and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement over full-image inference, inference time within 300s budget

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training and evaluation
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l provides different error profile from YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l (available in ultralytics 8.1.0) with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Evaluate standalone val_score. Also evaluate detection_mAP for potential use as detection-only model.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score logged, compared to best YOLO model

plan.title: RT-DETR-l nc=1 detection-only
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l as single-class detector may have different recall characteristics than YOLO
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=1 at 1280px. Compare detection_mAP against YOLO nc=1.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP compared, error analysis on which images each model does better

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves detection_mAP by 2-4 points
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and RT-DETR on val split. Merge predictions using Weighted Boxes Fusion (ensemble-boxes package). Sweep WBF IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6} and weights. Evaluate detection_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base classification comparison
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (vit_large), build gallery, run kNN classification on val detections. Compare classification_mAP against DINOv2-base. Measure model size and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison logged, size/time tradeoff documented

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A small MLP trained with ArcFace/SupCon loss on DINOv2 features improves classification over raw kNN
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train a 2-layer MLP projection head using ArcFace or supervised contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Use the projected embeddings for kNN classification. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves overall classification
plan.description: For each detection, compare YOLO nc=357 class confidence vs DINOv2 kNN similarity score. Use whichever is more confident (tune threshold on val split). Fall back to category_id=0 if neither is confident.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over either method alone

plan.title: Training with longer epochs and close_mosaic tuning
plan.hypothesis: Longer training (500+ epochs) with late mosaic closing improves model quality
plan.description: Retrain best YOLO model with epochs=500, close_mosaic=100. Compare against shorter training. Also test close_mosaic=150.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against shorter training run

plan.title: Label smoothing and focal loss for nc=357
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Retrain best YOLO model with label_smoothing=0.1. Compare val_score. Also test label_smoothing=0.05.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against no label smoothing

plan.title: Progressive resizing: 640→1280
plan.hypothesis: Starting at 640 then switching to 1280 gives faster convergence and potentially better generalization
plan.description: Train best YOLO model at 640 for 100 epochs, then resume at 1280 for 200 epochs. Compare val_score and total training time against training at 1280 from scratch.
plan.success_criteria: val_score and training time compared

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations improves classification robustness
plan.description: For each detection, extract 4 crop variations: original, center-zoomed (80% area), padded (120% area), slight brightness shift. Average DINOv2 embeddings before kNN lookup. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over single-crop, inference time acceptable

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching patch tokens instead of CLS token handles occlusion better
plan.description: Extract DINOv2 patch tokens for query crops and gallery entries. Compute patch-level similarity (e.g., average of top-k patch matches). Compare classification_mAP against CLS-token-only approach.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Using shelf section co-occurrence information improves classification of ambiguous products
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data (which categories appear in same images/sections). Use as Bayesian prior on DINOv2 classification probabilities. Evaluate val_score improvement.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from co-occurrence priors

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Synthetic augmentation using reference product photos improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: paste reference product images onto shelf backgrounds with perspective warps and lighting adjustments. Focus on categories with <5 training annotations. Retrain best model with augmented data.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, especially for rare categories

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Identify annotations with corrected=True. Duplicate these in training data (2x or 3x). Retrain best model. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against unweighted training

plan.title: ONNX export and INT8 quantization benchmarking
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization reduces model size with minimal accuracy loss
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX FP16 and INT8. Compare: (1) file sizes, (2) inference speed, (3) val_score for each. Also export DINOv2 to ONNX and test INT8.
plan.success_criteria: Size/speed/accuracy tradeoffs documented for FP16 vs INT8

plan.title: Smaller YOLO + tiling vs larger YOLO full image
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with tiling beats YOLOv8x on full image due to better effective resolution
plan.description: Compare: (a) YOLOv8x at 1280 full image, (b) YOLOv8m at 1280 with tiled inference (more tiles possible due to faster per-tile inference). Evaluate detection_mAP and total inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP and inference time comparison logged

plan.title: Rectangular inference (rect=True)
plan.hypothesis: Preserving aspect ratio during inference improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run best detector with rect=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP against square inference.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Per-category adaptive classification thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Category-specific confidence thresholds improve classification by avoiding errors on hard categories
plan.description: For each category, find optimal confidence threshold on val split that maximizes per-category AP. Categories with low confidence → fall back to category_id=0. Evaluate overall classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over fixed threshold

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test-time detections to DINOv2 gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: Implement two-pass inference: (1) run detector + classifier on all images, (2) add crops with score>0.85 to gallery, (3) re-classify all detections with augmented gallery. Evaluate val_score improvement.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from pseudo-labeling

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE and white balance
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detection on poorly lit shelf images
plan.description: Apply CLAHE and/or white balance correction to val images before detection. Compare detection_mAP against raw images.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Multi-scale WBF: same model at different resolutions
plan.hypothesis: Running the same model at 640, 1280, and 1920 and merging with WBF captures products at different scales
plan.description: Run best YOLO model at imgsz={640, 1280, 1920} on val split. Merge all predictions with WBF. Evaluate detection_mAP and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement over single-scale, time within budget

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal during WBF improves merged predictions
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from ensemble, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between crops. Upweight boxes that agree on embedding. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x at 1600px resolution
plan.hypothesis: 1600px captures more product detail than 1280 without excessive training cost
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at imgsz=1600 with batch=2 and gradient accumulation. Epochs=300. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared against 1280px training

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / oversampling rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling images with rare categories improves classification of those categories
plan.description: Implement image-level oversampling: duplicate images containing categories with <5 annotations. Retrain best model. Evaluate val_score, especially classification_mAP for rare categories.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement for rare categories

plan.title: Build optimized submission run.py
plan.description: Write run.py that: (1) loads best detector (ONNX or .pt), (2) loads DINOv2 + gallery, (3) implements tiled inference if beneficial, (4) runs classification pipeline, (5) outputs predictions.json. Ensure it works within sandbox constraints (no blocked imports, pathlib instead of os).
plan.success_criteria: run.py executes correctly on val images, produces valid predictions.json

plan.title: End-to-end timing test on val split
plan.hypothesis: Full pipeline completes within 300s for ~25 val images, extrapolating to ~300s for full test set
plan.description: Time the complete run.py pipeline on val split. Extrapolate to full test set size. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize if needed (batch DINOv2 inference, reduce tile count, etc.).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated full test set inference time < 300s

plan.title: Weight budget optimization
plan.hypothesis: All model weights fit within 420 MB with optimal quantization choices
plan.description: Measure exact sizes of all weight files. If over 420 MB, apply INT8 to least-sensitive model. Verify val_score after quantization.
plan.success_criteria: Total weight size < 420 MB, val_score minimally impacted

plan.title: DINOv2-small as lightweight alternative
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-small (~44 MB) frees budget for ensemble while maintaining acceptable classification
plan.description: If budget is tight, test DINOv2-small. Compare classification_mAP against base and large. Calculate budget savings.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP vs size tradeoff documented

plan.title: Two YOLO models ensemble + DINOv2-base
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x + RT-DETR-l ensemble with DINOv2-base fits in 420 MB and beats single model
plan.description: If both detectors fit in budget (with INT8 on one), test the full pipeline: ensemble detection + DINOv2 classification. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best single-detector pipeline, fits in 420 MB

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs standard NMS
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS preserves more true detections on dense shelves than hard NMS
plan.description: Implement Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay) as post-processing. Compare detection_mAP against standard NMS on val split.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Train with mixup and mosaic augmentation tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning augmentation parameters improves generalization
plan.description: Test training with: (a) mixup=0.1, (b) mosaic=0.5 (reduced), (c) copy_paste=0.1. Compare val_score against default augmentation.
plan.success_criteria: Best augmentation config identified

plan.title: Crop from full-resolution vs resized image for DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Cropping from original ~2000x1500 image gives better embeddings than from YOLO-resized image
plan.description: Compare DINOv2 classification_mAP when crops are extracted from: (a) original resolution image, (b) YOLO input resolution image. Ensure the pipeline uses full-res crops.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison, pipeline updated if full-res is better

plan.title: Category grouping: coarse then fine classification
plan.hypothesis: First classifying into store sections then fine-grained products reduces confusion
plan.description: Train a coarse classifier (4 sections) and use it to restrict the kNN search space. E.g., if section=Egg, only compare against egg products in gallery. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement from hierarchical classification

plan.title: Spatial context features for classification
plan.hypothesis: Including neighboring product context improves classification of ambiguous products
plan.description: For each detection, also extract embeddings of neighboring detections (left/right on shelf). Concatenate or average with target embedding. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Optimize DINOv2 batch inference
plan.hypothesis: Batching DINOv2 crop inference significantly reduces classification time
plan.description: Instead of processing crops one-by-one, batch all crops per image (or across images). Measure speedup. Ensure same accuracy.
plan.success_criteria: Inference time reduction documented, accuracy unchanged

plan.title: Final hyperparameter sweep on best pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Fine-tuning the last few hyperparameters squeezes out remaining val_score
plan.description: On the best overall pipeline, do a final sweep of: NMS threshold, confidence threshold, kNN k, gallery weights, WBF parameters. Use grid search on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Final optimized val_score logged

plan.title: Final run.py with all optimizations
plan.description: Update run.py with all winning configurations: best model(s), optimal thresholds, tiling if beneficial, DINOv2 pipeline, gallery. Ensure no blocked imports, correct output format, pathlib usage.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json on val split

plan.title: Final validation: complete pipeline test
plan.hypothesis: Final pipeline achieves the highest val_score seen across all experiments
plan.description: Run the complete final pipeline on val split. Verify: (1) val_score is best, (2) predictions.json format is correct, (3) inference time < 300s extrapolated, (4) total weight size < 420 MB.
plan.success_criteria: All constraints met, highest val_score confirmed

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission.zip containing: run.py, model weights (.pt or .onnx), gallery files, any helper .py files. Verify total uncompressed size < 420 MB. Document the best config and val_score for the human operator to retrain on full data.
plan.success_criteria: submission.zip created, all constraints verified, best config documented
